album.windowTitle: Fake Space Fog Machine — The Early Bird....
album.title: The Early Bird....
album.bio: "...i have no real idea if this'll take me anywhere or if there are any real prospects for making music in my future but it really doesnt matter to me because i have had an unimaginable amount of fun doing just this and its something i fully recommend doing yourself. like it may not be music, you may admire a different kind of art, you might have an entirely different passion, but i urge you to do make something good and bring it into this world because no one else can do it for you."
